desc:
Given an integer array nums (values may be negative) and a positive integer k, return the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose sum is divisible by k. If no non-empty subarray qualifies, return 0.

nums = [2, 7, 6, 1, 4, 5], k = 3
the block [7, 6, 1, 4] sums to 18, which is divisible by 3
result = 4
hints: Equal prefix remainders modulo k mean the block between them has a sum divisible by k.
To make a block as long as possible you want the earliest prefix with a given remainder, not the latest.

Store first[remainder] the first time it appears (the empty prefix gives first[0] = 0). For later prefixes with the same remainder, candidate length is j - first[remainder]; never overwrite the stored index.
editorial: Prefix remainders reduce the problem to: find two prefix positions i < j with P[i] % k == P[j] % k and maximise j - i. For each remainder the best left end is its first occurrence, so remember the first index per remainder and compare each later occurrence against it.

This is the mirror image of the shortest-subarray version: there you keep the latest index, here you keep the earliest. Seed the map with remainder 0 at index 0 so that prefixes starting at position 0 count. Time O(n), space O(min(n, k)).
